review_basis: Direct review of tagged public primary text. The distinct provenance obligation can fail independently of ContextEntry creation. Sections 9 and ACS-Trace and other duties in sections 6.4 and 9.1 are outside this admission.

relationships.external_proposition: Record the approver identity, granted capabilities and originating ASK step identifier in an intent extension ContextEntry.
relationships.fc_property: The property by which material actions and decisions remain reliably attributable to effective initiating and controlling actors, distinguishing human, model, agent, orchestrator, service, tool, policy, evaluator and infrastructure contributions, including transfers or shared control. Assess this property where material responsibility depends on distinguishing human direction, automated execution, agent-selected deviations or transfers of control. Preserved attribution can be Aligned even where the attributed conduct is harmful.
relationships.invariant: Each material action and decision record must identify the effective initiating and controlling actor or actors, distinguishing human, model, agent, orchestrator, service, tool, policy, evaluator, and infrastructure contributions and any transfer or sharing of control.
